entries.verified: Model Context Protocol docs, «Connect to local MCP servers», version 2026-07-28, read 2026-11-23 for Claude Desktop v6.28899.6 (2026-11-20): «All actions require your explicit approval before execution». An «Always allow» approval per tool (changelog v1.24012.9, 2026-07-24) is kept in the app's databases, which RosmarOps never opens; the factory behaviour is to ask before each MCP tool call.

Claude Desktop changelog, read 2026-11-23 for v6.28899.6 (2026-11-20): an «Always allow» approval per MCP tool persists (v1.24012.9, 2026-07-24, which added mcpPersistentAlwaysAllowEnabled so administrators can turn persistent approvals off). Those approvals are kept in the app's databases, which RosmarOps never opens, so the least controlled case is assumed, as for Cursor: the tools of its MCP servers and extensions run without asking (signed by Albert, 23-11). The factory fact, asking before each tool, is mcp_ask.
